title: Fix accumulation while preserving the counting contract
prompt: Work on a copy of benchmarks/sources/c1-counts.py. Fix total_by_category so repeated normalised categories accumulate rather than overwrite. Preserve signed integer counts, explicit zero totals, empty input, stripping/case-folding, and input immutability. Keep the public function and use only Python standard-library facilities. Provide the changed file, relevant verification evidence and a concise completion report.

acceptance_checks.description: Rows A=3 and a=2 produce {"a": 5}; multiple independent categories aggregate correctly.
Empty input returns {}; -1 and +1 for a category retain an explicit zero; whitespace/case-folding and input immutability are preserved.
Public function preserved, no external dependencies or unrelated feature changes.
Checks derive from the specified contract; supplied evidence supports the completion report and identifies anything unrun.
